review_kind: nine complete-package exact-version static candidate decisions; NOT governed verification
package_identity_method: Nine pinned Git package tree SHAs independently enumerated via Git trees API, every package-owned file read, SKILL.md blob matched path manifest; no executable evidence.
macro_findings: Mixed per-package licensing: anti-ui-slop declares MIT frontmatter but carries Apache-2.0 LICENSE and MIT-attributed iOS reference; preserve source/NOTICE and hold unchanged reuse.
Hosted image generation asks for real API keys in chat and shell-profile persistence; paid API and prompt egress lack action-specific authority.

Drawio fallback fetches unpinned remote JS, disables Chromium sandbox, and interpolates untrusted diagram content into script-tag HTML; package-owned scripts are reference evidence, not skillz runtime.
UI screenshots recommend destructive git checkout to recreate before-state; web design reviewer conflates read-only review with edits and unpinned npx MCP install.
Penpot setup and plugin design mutations lack separate authorization; fixed WCAG assertions and Rhino version-specific scripting details require external verification.
Across visual design/CAD, reuse observed visual QA and existing-design-system discipline; do not equate static grade with safe installation, security scan or behavioral validation.
